What city are you interested in?
Los Angeles, please. Will it be hot?
It will be hot today in Los Angeles.
Yes, can you give me the information on the Huntingdon Marriott Hotel?
Absolutely. It is an expensive hotel located in the west part of town. It has 4 starts and includes free wifi and parking. Would you like help booking a room?
Yes please, I need a reservation for 6 people for 5 nights starting on Saturday.
Sorry, there are not enough rooms available for that time period. Perhaps a different day or a shorter stay might yield better results.
How about for 1 night? If that works, I'll need a reference number of course.
Booking was successful. Your reference number is : OO8QDA62.
I need a train from London Kings Cross to Cambridge.
I have 70 trains travelling that route. To narrow it down, what day would you like to leave and what time would you like to depart/arrive?
sure, I would like to go on Saturday, and arrive by 20:20. As close to that time as I can arrive.
I have a 19:17 from London that arrives at 20:08. Would that work for you?
Yes, let me have 7 tickets, please.
Booking was successful, the total fee is 132.16 GBP payable at the station. Reference number is : QMD5P3EG. Is there anything else I can help you with?
I need to find a shopping center.
The Stanford Shopping Center at 773 Alger Dr is 3 miles away in no traffic. Would you like directions there?
Yes please.
I sent all the info on the screen, please drive carefully!
Schedule meeting.

Please set it for the 13th at 11am. It is going to be with management and to discuss our company picnic. Thank you.

utterances_en: Hello, I'm looking for a train. I need to leave on Wednesday from Norwich.
Any idea where you want to go?
I am looking to go to Cambridge.
To help narrow down the choices, what time would you like to depart at?
i'm leaving after 09:00.
how about TR1180 that leaves at 09:16?
What is the Price and travel time?
It is 17.60 pounds per person and the travel time is 79 minutes.
Ok great, can you book it for me please?
You are booked fee will be 17.6 payable at the station, the refernece number is BT2I3WGS. Anything else today?
I need a hotel on the north side with free parking.
Okay, there are 11 places to stay that might work. Would you prefer a guesthouse or a hotel?
I'd prefer a moderate price guesthouse.
That leaves us with about 7 options. Can I suggest the Acorn Guest House? It is a 4 star moderately priced guesthouse in the north.
That sounds fine. Would you make a reservation for 4 people, 3 nights starting Monday?
Your booking was successful and reference number is 3ZYK9LO1. Is there anything else I may assist you with?
Is there a nearby rest stop?
Hotel Keen and The Westin are both nearby.
Which has the least amount of traffic at the moment.
They both have none.
What is the address for Keen?
578 Arbol Dr, we're 2 miles away from it. Set the navigation there?
what time is my optometrist appointment
You have two optometrist's appointments scheduled; one for the 2nd at 4 pm with father and one the 12th at 10 am with Jeff.
Can you find me a guesthouse with free parking?
I certainly can look for that for you. It looks like I have several. Do you prefer a certain price range?
No, but I'm looking for something with at least two stars.
Sorry, we don't have anything that matches the options that you've selected. Would you like to search for a different option?
Do you have a hotel that is four stars then?
We have several! Do you wish to stay in a certain part of town?
The location doesn't matter, but I would prefer a guesthouse if possible.
I would recommend the Acorn Guest House then. It has 4 stars, free wifi, free parking and is moderately priced. Would you like to book a room?
Yes please. There are 8 of us and we'll be arriving on Saturday.
Can you please give me how many days you will be staying?
I'll be staying for 5 nights.
I have you book for that time, the reference code is UA3N0Q3R.

There is Royal Spice which serves Indian food and Da Vinci Pizzeria which serves Italian food. Would you like me to book you a table at either of these restaurants?
Royal Spice sounds good. Can you reserve a table for 8 at 15:45 on Saturday?
Unfortunately, I was not able to book for that specific time and day. Can I try a different day or time for you?
How about at 14:45?
I've booked it for that day on Saturday. Reference number 9PVIPW1Y. Anything else?
I want to make a booking at the alexander bed and breakfast.
Ok. How many nights would you like to book?
4 nights please.
What are the dates you are staying?
I will be staying four nights starting on Friday.
How many people will be staying?
4 people will be staying for 4 nights starting from Friday.
Ok. Your booking was successful and the reference number is TD8TU8IO.
is it going to rain this week
Which city are you interested in?
Corona
There will be rain on Wednesday and a drizzle on Saturday for Corona this week.
take me to the nearest chinese restaurant
There are Jing Jing 4 miles away and Panda Express 6 miles away: since there is no traffic on the route to Panda Express I vote for its chicken with orange and shrimps with nuts.
What is the address of Jing Jing.
Jing Jing is at 113 Arbol Dr.
Set GPS for a route with no traffic please.
The only route to Jing Jing has moderate traffic. Is that okay?
Yes that's fine. Please set the GPS.
GPS is set to Jing Jing at 113 Arbol Dr.
I am looking for a place to dine. The restaurant should be in the east and should be in the moderate price range
The Curry Prince restaurant is in the east and is moderately priced. Their phone is 01223566388.
Thank you for the help.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Yes, could you book me a table for 6 at 19:45 on Saturday?
Your table is reserved. Your reference number is U60SC89J. May I help you with something else?
Would you confirm this is an Indian restaurant, please? It sounds like one.
Yes it is an Indian restaurant in the east.
Great, that is all I need today. Thank you.
You're welcome. Thank you so much for calling us today.

Where are you departing from and where is your destination?
I will be departing from Cambridge. My destination is Birmingham New Street.
I've got lots of available trains that will get you there. Do you have a preferred time you want to leave or arrive?
I want to leave after 08:15, arrival isn't that important.
I have one leaving Cambridge at 9:01 and arriving in Birmingham at 11:44. Would you like to book this one?
Yes. Would you please provide me with the reference number?
I have booked you and your reference number is 93NZYRZQ.
Hello, I am looking for a restaurant by the name of Royal Standard. Do you know where it is?
Yes, royal standard is in the city centre at 290 Mill Road.
Great. Could you please book a table for 1 at 16:30 on Saturday?
I was able to make a reservation for 1 at the royal standard. Your reference number is: FZP2XK9Q. Do you need anything else today?
What time is the football game and who will be there?
Your football activity with Jeff is at 11 am.
I need to find a restaurant in the west part of town. It should be in the cheap price range.
I have a Vietnamese and an Italian restaurant matching your requirements. Would you be interested in either?
I'd prefer the Italian one.
I have La Margherita that is a cheaper italian restaurant. It's located at 15 Magdalene Street City Centre. Did you need any help booking a table?
Can I get the postcode for it?
Absolutely! The postcode for La Margherita is cb30af. Would you like me to make a reservation for you?
Yes, please. Thank you very much.
Great! What day and time would you like the reservation for?
Am injured and are looking for a hospital nearby
The Addenbrookes Hospital is located at Hills Rd, Cambridge Postcode CB20QQ
That may be good. How many minutes away is that hospital?
Where are you currently located?

utterances_en: I am looking for a train departing from London Kings Cross.
I have 70 trains departing from that location, do you have any more information to narrow it down some?
Yes, I'd like to go to Cambridge on Tuesday, sometime after 13:15.
Train TR3456 leaves London Kings Cross at 13:17 and arrives in Cambridge at 14:08. Would you like to book this train?
I think that will work. What is the ticket price and travel time for that train?
The ticket price is 23.60 pounds. Travel time on this route is 51 minutes. Would you like me to arrange a booking on this train?
Yes, that sounds good.
Great, I have booked your ticket. Your reference number is : 3TF3UIGP.
Okay thank you for all your help.
You're quite welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Could you help me find a moderately priced guesthouse?
Yes, there are 15 places that are moderately priced guesthouses. Is there a certain area of town that you prefer?
I'd prefer something in the center of town that has free wifi.
I apologize but we don't have anything that fits your criteria. Would you like to change the area or try a hotel?
Oh, that's a bummer. Ok, how about trying in the north?
Of course! I have 8 options: 7 of which have 4 stars and 1 has 3 stars. Would you like more information?
The stars don't matter. Please book one for 3 people for 5 nights, starting Sunday.
That booking was unsuccessful. Will any other length of stay or starting day be possible?
Let's try to start on Monday.
I'm sorry, but there's nothing available starting on Monday.
I actually would like it to be on Sunday for 2 nights.
I have reserved 2 nights for 3 people starting on Sunday at the Acorn Guest house which is in the north of the city, is moderately priced and has internet. Reference K0RIYU4Z.
I was in a car accident dispute and I am looking for help
When and where did this accident occur?
I just need an address and phone number for the police please
Absolutely! The police station phone number is 01223358966 and their address is Parkside, Cambridge. What else can I do to help?
I'd like a taxi to the cafe jello gallery please.
I would be happy to help you with that. I will need to know where you are departing from and what time you'd like picked up.
I'd like to picked up from cafe jello gallery after 12:30.
I'm sorry. It seems like your destination and departure site are the same. Could you clarify where you'd like to go and where you'd like to be picked up from?
So Sorry, i want to leave cafe jello gallery after 12:30 going to the junction.
That's no problem. I book a White Skoda for you, picking you up at 12:30. The contact # is 07258655313. Can I assist you further?
I'm are looking for a train. The train should go to cambridge and should leave on saturday.
Where will you be departing from?
I will be departing from Norwich.
What tie would you like to leave Norwich?
I would like to leave after 14:30 .
I have several trains. How would TR1156 work for you, it leaves at 15:16 arriving at 16:35?
Yes. That works. I need 3 tickets, please.
Booking was successful, the total fee is 70.4 GBP payable at the station . Reference number is : 1MI35913.

I am looking for a train to cambridge.

Yes, thank you. Can you book it for 3 people and provide the reference number for me?

TR8699 departs Tuesday at 12:11 and arrives in Cambridge at 12:58. Would you like to book it?
No, I am not sure I am traveling just yet. Thanks for the information, I am all set for now. Have a nice day.
Okay, is there anything else I can help you with?
I am trying to find a really neat museum to visit. Would you be able to tell me whats available out there?
We have many interesting museums, such as the Cambridge Artworks, Cambridge Museum of Technology, and the Whipple Museum of the History of Science. Anything in particular strike your fancy?
Are any of them in the centre?
Actually, I have 11 of them in the centre area. Might I suggest the Broughton House Gallery. It has free entrance and is located at 98 King Street.
That would be perfect. Can I get the phone number, please?
Yes. Their phone number is 01223314960. Can I help you with anything else?
Hi, I need a 4 star guesthouse hotel please.
I have 21 4 star places, can you tell me what area you would like to be in?
The North part of town, please.
There are quite a few. If you'd like a cheap alternative, I can recommend Worth House, on Chesterton Road. Or for a moderate rate, Kirkwood House is next door.
Could you book the Kirkwood House for me for thursday, 6 people and 5 nights?
Your booking was successful. The reference number is 6G15LHZM. Is there anything else?
I need a train from leicester sometime after 9:30.
I can assist you with that. What day would you like to leave?
I need to be in Cambridge on Monday please.
Very well. The earliest train is TR0032, which leaves at 10:09. Is that alright?
Could you give me the arrival time and price on that please?
TR0032 arrives at 11:54 and costs 37.80 pounds. May I book that for you?
Yes, that would be terrific.
Great, I have booked your ticket, your reference number is : I6NJ8FUB. may I help you with anything else?

There should not be any frost in Atherton on Friday

I'm sorry there are no 1 star hotels with internet, would you like me to search on 2 stars, we have a few hotels available.
Alright. I wanted a 1 star, but I guess I can listen to the 2 star options.
I have 2 on the north side that are in the moderate price range and 1 on the east side in the expensive range. Would you like to book one.
Hmm. What do you what about 4 star hotels?
There are 5 guesthouses with 4 star ratings in Cambridge with moderate to cheap price ranges. Would you like more information?
Well, I'd like to book one. I don't think it matters which one.
What dates would you like to book the room for?
I need it for two nights starting on Saturday.
Okay, how many people will be in your party?
It would be for 7 people.
I have booked you at the A and B Guest House at 124 tenison road. The reference number is 0J08KUGQ. Can I help you with anything else?
Hi, I'm looking for a train from Stevenage to Cambridge
What day do you need the ticket for? Trains leave every hour.
I am travelling on Monday and need to leave after 16:30.
The TR0244 leaves at 17:21 and arrives by 18:10. Would you like this one?
Yes please. What is the cost for this train?
My apologies. The train ID is TR0254 not TR0244. The cost is 12.80 pounds per ticket. Can I book a ticket for you?
Yes, that would be great. Please book for 6 people.
Yes that booking was successful and your reference number for the trip and tickets is PENZQ430. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
I am trying to find a hotel called warkworth house
Call them at 01223363682
book it for 3 people and 5 nights starting from thursday.
Your booking was unsuccessful. Could you book another day or a shorter stay?
Let's try for Friday instead. And I need the reference number please.
Your booking was successful and your Reference number is : 0DW45IKS

I am sorry to hear of your injury. Addenbrookes Hospital is a fine facility at Hills Rd, Cambridge.

The phone number is 01223245151 and the Postcode is CB20QQ. Is there anything else I can help with?
What is the address so I can find the hospital?
It's at Hills Rd, Cambridge with Postcode CB20QQ
Could you tell me if you have a 5 star hotel on the south side?
Unfortunately, I don't happen to have anything that meets your specifications. Can I look in another area for you?
It really needs to be in the south and have a 5 star rating. It can be a hotel or guesthouse though.
I'm sorry but there are no hotels are guesthouses with a 5 star rating in the south. Would you like to try a 4 star rating instead?
Yeah, that would be fine.
We have 2 guesthouses that match your needs. aylesbray lodge guest house or rosa's bed and breakfast. Does either of these fancy your interest?
Do either of them have internet? I'll also take the address for both.
Yes, they both do. Aylesbray is at 5 Mowbray Road, and Rosa's is located at 53 Roseford Road.
Thanks for the information!
You are welcome, do you need any thing else?

Please book for 4 people.
What is your arrival day and number of days you wish to stay?

which days will be cloudy this week

Something cheap would be good.

No not really. But I would prefer a hotel and like both free wifi and parking if possible.

That's fine. I'll need it for three nights starting on Sunday.

Is there another hotel that matches that criteria?

I will try and restate so you can look again, I need free wifi and parking, cheap place, type of room does not matter.

It doesn't matter. Whatever is available nearby will be fine.
I will give it a try again. How many people will there be?
there are 4 of us.

I am hoping you can find a guesthouse in the north part of town for me.
I found five guesthouses. In order to narrow down the choices, would you like one that has internet or parking?
Well I would like one that's in a moderate price range. It needs to include free parking.
There are 7 guesthouses in the north that are moderately priced and all have parking, I apologise for the earlier error. Do you have a preference to star numbers?
No, that doesn't matter. I need to book one for Wednesday.
How about the Archway House? How manny days would you like to stay, and how many in your group?
Yes, that works. I'd like to book 3 days for 7 people. I also need the reference number as well.
I'm afraid there's no availability for that time. Can we try a different day or length of stay?
2 nights, then.
I am sorry, that hotel is not open for that booking. Should I try another hotel?
Yes, please. Something in the north, again.

I need a taxi to go to anatolia

Yes I want to arrive at 20:45

I'm leaving from castle galleries.

Im going to cambridge

Booking was successful, the total fee is 302.39 GBP payable at the station . Reference number is : 3P7B0D6T.
thank you for your help

utterances_en: I'm looking for a hotel with at least a three-star rating.
We have 6 hotels and guesthouses that have 3 star ratings. Is there a particular part of town, or a particular price range that you're interested in?
I'm not to worried about price but the hotel needs to have free wifi.
The gonville hotel is in the centre and the lensfield hotel is in the south.They both have free wifi. Would you like me to book one for you?
Not just yet. I'm just getting info now.
Understood. Do you need anything else then?
Oh I forgot to mention I would actually like something in the moderate price range.
We have 4 to choose from now. Any other preferences?
Are they all guesthouses?
Yes, they are all guesthouses. Can I suggest the hamilton lodge, a 3 star, moderately priced guesthouse with wifi, in the north area?
Please give me the number to the hamilton lodge.
Certainly. It's 01223365664. Would you like me to book it for you?
No, I won't be booking today. Can you just give me the address?
Sure, it is at 156 chesterton road. Do you need any other information today?
Car I'm desiring to have some pizza! Is there any pizzeria in the local area?
Pizza My Heart is located at 528 Anton Ct 6 miles away in moderate traffic. Would you like directions there?
Yes, please pick a route with no traffic
Setting navigation now.
I am looking for a place to stay. The hotel doesn't need to have free parking and should be in the north
There are 11 entries in the north. What price range are you looking for?
50 to 75 dollars
when would you like to move into the room
I would like to move in on Saturday and stay for 4 nights.
The alpha-milton guest house is available, which is a 3 star hotel. Would you like me to reserve it for you?
I also need to make sure it has free wifi and can accommodate two people.
Booking was unsuccessful. Please book another day or a shorter stay
How about starting on Sunday?
I'm sorry the Alpha-Minton doesn't have free wifi. I booked you into the Avalon starting Saturday, which you wanted.
Thanks! May I have the reference number?
Sure! That is BANQDUCA.
i am doing yoga with my brother Wednesday
Do you want me to set a reminder?
Yes, set a reminder for an hour before 11am.
Okay, setting a reminder for Wednesday at 10am for yoga with your bro.
Hello. Can you help me find a hotel in the North of town?
I have 2 hotels in the north, would you like to book one?
Are either of them moderately priced? Do they include free wifi?
We have 2 hotels and 8 guesthouses that match your needs. Do you have additional requirements?
Could you book me into one of the 2 hotels please.
How about the ashley hotel? How many people in your party?
But I'm not sure from what you said - is the Ashley priced moderately, and do they have free wifi? We are 3 people and we'd like to stay 4 nights.
Ashley hotel is moderately priced and has free wifi. What night would you like to begin your stay?
I would like it to start Sunday.
You have your reservation at the Ashley, reference number BOF076G4.

utterances_en: i am looking for the Addenbrookes Hospital
Addenbrookes Hospital is located on Hills Rd, Cambridge. Is there a department you're needing the phone number for?
I need the emergency department. Could I also get the postcode?
Sure, the emergency department number is 01223217118.
What is the postcode?
Their postcode is CB20QQ. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
What is my address?
You live at 5671 barringer street.
Can you set the navigation for there?
Navigation set for 5671 barringer street.
Are there any Mexican restaurants in the centre?
Sorry no, there are no Mexican restaurants in the centre of town. Would you like to check another area?
Sure. I would be interested in Indian restaurants also.
Curry Garden is in that part of town and they serve Indian food.
Please book this for 7 people, at 18:00 on Sunday.
Unfortunately there is nothing available for 18:00 on Sunday. Would another date or time work for you?
Try 17:00 on Sunday.
Of course. You're booked at 17:00 with reference number TTP6GYCJ. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes. May I assist with anything else?
navigate to the nearest mall
We are 2 miles away from Midtown Shopping Center: would you like to go there?
Please send me the address and pick the fastes route to go there, thanks!
Midtown Shopping Center is located at 338 Alester Avenue, which is 2 miles away.
Please pick the fastest way for me and don't be repetitive car, you're not doing well your job!
I'm sorry, I'm doing my best.. I picked the best route for you, enjoy your trip!
what is the weather today in tomorrow
What city do you want the forecast for?
Please tell me the weather report for Menlo Park today.
In Menlo Park today is going to be foggy, low of 60F, high of 70F and tomorrow is going to be rain, low of 30F, high of 40F.

Sure! Where is your departure site?
I want to depart from the Riverside Brasserie.
I can help you with that. When do you need to leave?
It doesn't matter, just so I arrive by 18:15.
I can help you with that. where are you going?
I want to go to the Shanghai Family Restaurant. And I need the car type and contact number please.
Okay, I have a black bmw for you with the contact number 07678946250. Is there anything else you need today?
Check the next 48 hours and tell me is alameda will be misty.
No, it's not gonna be misty in Alameda in next 48 hours: today there is rain and tomorrow it will be hot

What are your departure and arrival locations?
I'll be going from cambridge to broxbourne.
I have a train that leaves at 12:01 and arrives by 13:01. Would you like me to book that train?
Yes, I will need 2 tickets please.
Train id TR4266 leaves at 12:01 and arrives at 13:01. Would you like me to book that one?
Yes, for 2 people please. Can I also get the reference #? Thanks!
Your booking was successful. You will owe 35.79 GBP at the station and your reference number is: TQICKHXG. Can I assist you with anything else?
I'm looking for a guesthouse with free parking.
Do you have a preferred location or price range?
I'm not too concerned with location, but I would like it to include internet and have a 4 star rating please.
There are 16 guesthouses that meet those requirements. Any preference on price range?
Not really. Anything would be fine.
I recommend the Acorn Guest House. Would you like a room there?
Yes, please. I'd like to book it for 6 people and 5 nights starting from monday.
Booking unsuccessful. Want to try for a shorter stay?
Yes, how about 3 nights?
That was a successful booking, your reference number is T6C83P46.
what is the forecast for new york city

Okay, will there be clear skies on thursday?

the cambridge belfry is a hotel located in the west and is cheap. Has 4 stars and free internet and parking.
I would like to make a reservation for this Saturday for 2 people for 4 nights please.
I have booked you and another person for this Saturday for 4 nights.
Awesome, what about reference number?
Sure, my bad! The reference number is 169N4VTV. Do you need anything else?
Hello, I'm looking to book a taxi to Cocum.
All right, when would you like to depart?
After 2:30, please.
Certainly. I'm sending a grey toyota. The contact number is 07520577289. Can I help you with anything else?
I will need the taxi to depart from archway house.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
Hi, I'm looking for an upscale hotel. Could you recommend me anywhere in the west part of the area?
Huntingdon Marriott Hotel is available in the west part of town and looks upscale.
Does it have a star of 4 and free parking?
Yes. Would you like to book a room?
Yes, most likely. Can you provide me with the postcode of the hotel please?
Yes, the postcode is pe296fl. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
I need a taxi to arrive by 09:45
I'd be happy to help! Where are you coming from?
The pickup location will be finches bed and breakfast
Ok, I will also need your destination for booking purposes.
I will be traveling to sidney sussex college today.
Do you have a time you would like to leave by?
Is 9:00 good? Do you think forty-five minutes is enough time to get to the college?
Yes, the taxi will pick you up at 9:00. It is a yellow lexus.
Great. Can I get a contact number?
Of course, the contact number is 07336173784. Is there anything else you need?
Hello, I am looking for information on kambar. What do you know about that attraction?
Kambar is a nightclub located in the centre of town. Its address is 1 wheeler street and postcode is cb23qb with an entrance fee of 5 pounds.
Alright, that's all I really needed to know. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Have a great day!

Tom.

utterances_en: Hi, can you help me find a 4 star place to stay?

Yes, can you please change the location to centre?
We have one 4 star hotel that is in the centre, University Arms Hotel, it has internet and parking and is expensive, would this one suit you?
That will be fine. Can you book me a room for Saturday, please?
Certainly. How long would you like to stay, and how many are in your party?
I'll be arriving Saturday and staying 3 nights. There are 3 of us.
Unfortunately, we cannot book you for those days. Could you change the number of days?
Sure, try for two days?
That was unsuccessful too. Wanna try something else?
Is there another one in the Centre with that critera avaible?
No, I'm sorry. I am searching for a 4 star hotel in the centre for 2 nights on Saturday. Is that correct?
I need the hotel for 3 nights starting on Saturday please.
Would you like to change the number of days you are staying. I was unable to find anything.
No, please continue the search.
I'm sorry, but the University Arms does not have anything available on Saturday for 3 people, for a 3 night stay. Would you like to try a different day?
I am so sorry. Could you just change the number of people in my party to 5 and try again?
That worked, I guess you just needed a larger room. Your reference number is PR0ABUBI. Can I be of further assistance?
I need some help with a car accident I was in.
I'm sorry to hear about your accident, would you like the number for Parkside Police Station?
Yes please, that would be great.
there you go Telephone : 01223358966
Great, thank you.
You are welcome. Is that all for today?

You are quite welcome. Do you require any further assistance?

can i book for you?

I'm leaving from pizza express fen ditton

But of course. I just need a bit more info. What time do you want to leave and on what day?
I want to leave on Monday. It doesn't matter what time the train leaves as long as I arrive by 14:00.
Just to confirm: Is your destination Cambridge or another city?
Yes, my destination is Cambridge, and I'll be coming in from Broxbourne.
Okay, that helps give us a good start, what day are you wanting to travel?
Monday, please. For 6 people.

The Booking for TR0354 was successful, the total fee is 107.4 GBP payable at the station . Reference number is : 8UV8Y3A7.

The address to the police is Parkside, Cambridge.
I also would like the postcode.
The postcode is CB11JG
All right, thank you very much for your help.
You are welcome. May I help you with anything else?
Hello! I'm looking for a train arriving by 10:30 to cambridge.
That are several options that arrive in Cambridge by 10:30. When are you traveling and where are you departing from?
I am departing from leicaster and it will be on thursday
Four trains will get you there by 10:30. Would you prefer to depart at 6:54, 7:54, 8:54 or 9:54?
9:54 sounds good. What is the price? And how long is the trip?
I beg your pardon, but the times I mentioned earlier were for arrival rather than departure. The departure times are 5:09. 6:09. 7:09, and 8:09. What is your preference?
Can you tell me what the travel time is and the price?
Which train would you like that for?
The 8:09 departure, please.
That's train TR6180. The travel time is 105 minutes, and the cost is 37.80 pounds per ticket.
Yes I am looking for information on a restaurant called Bangkok City.
That is an expensive Thai restaurant. Do you want me to book a reservation?
Yes, 5 people, friday at 14:15.
Sorry, there are no tables available for your party then. Perhaps another day or time?
Oh no. Can you get us in at 13:15 then?
Yes, that time is available, and I've reserved your table. The reference number is WI602I6M.

utterances_en: Hello there! Can you tell me if there are any 4-star hotels or guesthouses in Cambridge that are cheap?
There are 21 locations, do you have any other requirements?
I am hoping it is a guesthouse
There are 7 guesthouses meeting your requirements. Is there a particular area you wish to stay in?
No, as long as it's cheap and have 4 stars. Can you recommend me one and book it for 8 people and 3 nights starting Thursday?
Sure the Autumn House is a personal favorite. Your booking was successful.
Great. What was the reference number for the booking?
Yes, it's 1GFITCAU.
OK. Thanks for your help. I look forward to the stay.
Wonderful. Have a nice time. Can I reserve a taxi for you?
Where is the parking garage in the area?
There is Stanford Oval Parking, it's 4 miles away: does it sound good?
What is the address?
Stanford Oval Parking is at 610 Amarillo Ave.
I'd like to find a train to peterborough.
There are 266 trains going to Peterborough. Can you give me a departure day and time so that I can narrow down your choices?
I am looking to go from cambridge, and go on friday arriving by 14:30
Okay, how about the TR5901 leaving at 13:34 and arriving at 14:24 with a duration of 50 minutes? The cost is 16.50 pounds. Would that work for you?
That would be perfect!
Great, how many tickets would you like to purchase?
7 tickets please. Can I also have the reference number for the booking?
Your tickets are all booked, reference number R5P65TW5
I'm looking for a place to dine.
Certainly. What type of food interests you?
I like ethnic food, particularly Indian food.
Great, I have a bunch of options for you. Do you have a certain area and price range you are looking for?
The restaurant should be in the expensive price range and should serve indian food.
There are 14 expensive Indian restaurants. Which area do you prefer?
Area does not matter to me. Please Book it for 5 people at 19:30 on Wednesday. I also need the reference number.
I'm sorry, sir, I'm having trouble making that booking. Would you like to try for a different time or a different day?
Yes, Please book 5 people at 18:30. I also need the reference number.
Your booking was successful. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes. The reference number is XOT3L3NR.
I'm looking for a nightclub to go to. Are there any in the centre of town?
There are 5 nightclubs in the centre. Ballare is one of them. Would that work for you?
Is there an entrance fee for Ballare?
The fee is 5 pounds.

utterances_en: Hi, I'm looking for a local upscale chinese restaurant.
There are 9 restaurants that meet your criteria. Want to try Yu Garden on 529 Newmarket Road Fen Ditton or a different one?
Actually, I'm looking for somewhere that's located near the centre. Could you recommend somewhere near there?
The Ugly Duckling restaurant is an expensive Chinese restaurant near the center of town. Would you like me to make a reservation for you?
Yes, please.
For how many people and at what time/day?
It's for 5 people and we want to eat at 13:30 on saturday.
Booking was successful. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes. Reference number is : TZPTJJA5.
I'm looking for a sports facility in the town centre.
Unfortunately, I do not have any sports attractions in the centre of town. Can I look in another area or for a different type of attraction?
How about a museum instead?
How about, the Cambridge Contemporary Art Museum located at 6 trinity street?
That sounds good. What is their phone number?
The number there is 01223324222. Anything else?
What's their postcode, and how much is it to get in?
There is no entrance fee; it is free. The postcode is cb21su. May I help you with anything else?
what's the weather going to be today and also what is the weather going to be this week
What city are you inquiring about?
Exeter, will it frost there today?
No, frost is not predicted in Exeter today.
Can you help me find a hotel with free parking?
There are 8 hotels with free parking. Do you prefer a specific area in town?
north area of town
There are two hotels in that area with free parking: Ashley Hotel and the Lovell lodge. Would you like to book either of those?
Actually, I'd like a guest house.
how about hamilton lodge? It sounds lovely.
Is it moderately priced? Area actually doesn't matter as long as it is a 3 star moderately priced guest house
It is moderate price, would you like more info or a booking?
Yes, and I would also like the address?
Hamilton Lodge is located at 156 chesterton road, postcode cb41da. Would you like to make a reservation?
No that won't be necessary. Thanks for your help.
You are welcome. Do you need any more information or do you have any transportation needs?

utterances_en: I want a restaurant in the town centre. Can you help me?
We have 69 restaurants available. Could you specify type or price range please?
I'm looking for a moderately priced restaurant. I'm looking to book for just myself at 14:00 on Friday.
Okay I took the liberty of booking you into the Oak Bistro that serves traditional British food. Your reference number is BA2MQ3EB.
I was in an argument about a car accident and need help
Parkside Police Station will help you. Their telephone number is 01223358966.
Hi, I need to book a taxi, please? I need to leave sometime after 10:30.
I would love to help you with that. Where would you like to be picked up, and where are you going?
I would like to be picked up at the cambridge belfy and go to the cambridge shop.
I'm sorry, are you going to the Cambridge chop house, or did you mean the cambridge shop?
The chop house.
I have you booked. A yellow lexus will pick you up at 10:30. The contact number is 07463778759. Will there be anything else?
I'm sorry, I need to leave after 10:30, could you change the reservation?
Yes, I have you arranged to be picked up by a black Honda at 10:45.
I could really use something to eat.
I have over 100 restaurants to choose from, would you mind narrowing down your search for me with perhaps a food type or price range?
Expensive restaurant in the centre, please.
Any particular type of food you're hankering for?
Not really. Which is your favorite? I'll book that for 13:00 Thursday. There will be 6 of us.
I'm sorry, I have not found anything for that time yet. Can you choose another day or time please? Are you sure you don't have a preference for food type?
Let's try to book it for 12:00 then for 6 people on Thursday. I'll also need a reference number.
Which restuarant do you want to book at?
I'm not sure. Just something expensive. We are celebrating.
I booked you at Curry Queen. Your table will be reserved for 15 minutes. Reference number is C06RJUNL.
I need to find the fastest route to the nearest gas station.
Chevron is 5 miles away with moderate traffic. You want that address?
Yes sounds good.
Chevron is located at 783 Arcadia Pl. Do you want me to set the GPS?
Yes please.
GPS set to 783 Arcadia Pl.

utterances_en: What attractions are in the town centre?
In the centre of town I have a total of 79 different attractions, would you like to narrow your search by entrance fee or zip code?
What different attraction types are there in the centre?
There are museums, colleges, architectural buildings, parks, nightclubs, etc. Does any of that sound interesting?
What museum would you recommend?
I recommend the Broughton House Gallery at 98 King Street. It's free to enter and a great museum.
Thanks so much, that's very helpful. Could I get the postcode as well, please?
The postcode for the Broughton House Gallery is cb11ln.
What types of pizza can I get around here
There is a Pizza Chicago and Round Table.
Which is closer?
Pizza Chicago is closer.
What is the address?
Pizza Chicago's address is 915 Arbol Dr.
I am at Ballare. I need a taxi to take me to Hobsons House.
Sure! When do you want to leave?
I need to get there by 17:45.
Booking completed! Booked car type : yellow honda Contact number : 07660102698
Hi, I am looking to go to a place with multiple sports in the centre. Can you help me?
The cherry hinton village centre is available if that works for you?
Is that a multiple sports attraction in the centre? How much does it cost?
No, the only multiple sports place is in the east. Would you prefer that one, or perhaps a different type of attraction in the centre?
I'd like to definitely see something in the centre of town. How about a museum? Can you recommend a nice one?
There are 5 museums in the centre of town. All with free admission. My favorite is Castle Galleries on St. Andrews Street.
Excellent, can I get the address and post code please?
Of course! The postcode is cb23bj and it is located at Unit su43, Grande Arcade, Saint Andrews Street. Can I assist you with anything else?
I need a cheap place to stay in the centre of town, please.

utterances_en: Greetings! Can you help me in locating a train to get me to Cambridge?
Certainly. Can you please tell me the location you are departing from and what day you would like to leave?
Sure. I need to leave on Friday from Broxbourne.
We have several trains for that day. Did you have a particular time you wanted to leave?
I am going to need to leave sometime later than 17:15. I will need 6 seats.
There are 7 trains available. When would you like to arrive bye?
It doesn't matter, I just need to leave sometime after 17:15.
I can book you on TR4322 from broxbourne to cambridge. It leaves at 17:32 and arrives by 18:32. Would you like that?
Yes please, for 6 people.
I booked 6 seats on TR4322, the price is 107.4 GBP and your reference number is RZUTECIJ. Is there anything else I can do for you?
I was in a car accident and I need some help
Sure! I think you'll need the police. Their contact number is 01223358966.
May I also have the address and the post code?
The address is Parkside, Cambridge and the telephone number is 01223358966.
I would like to get a taxi to pick me up after 16:45.
We can make that happen, but first I'll need to know your departure and destination locations.
I will be going to Jesus College from the Nirala.
Okay. A blue volvo is booked for you.
Great, I will also need their contact number please.
Yes, the contact number is 07047852975. Is there anything else you need?
Please connect me to the Parkside Police Station.
The number to the local police station is 01223358966.
I need to find a 4 star hotel that also has free parking.
I have 19 places to stay with 4 stars and parking, which area would you prefer?
I would like to be in the north area.
There are no hotels that fit your criteria. However, there are 7 guesthouses available. Would you like me to book one of those for you?
Are there any guesthouses with free wifi?
Yes, all 7 guesthouses have internet available. What price range are you looking for?
Oh, cool. It really doesn't matter. Which would you recommend?
How about Acorn Guest House?
How much per night?
It is moderately priced. I don't have an exact price.
OK, I don't need a room right now, but can I have the post code and phone number for Acorn?
Sure. Postcode cb41da and phone number 01223353888. Is there anything else I can do for you?

No problem. Where is your departure area and destination?
I need to go to stansted airport and will be departing from cambridge
The closest to 13:45 is 14:40, which is the TR1316. It arrives at Stansted Airport at 15:08. Do you still want to book it?
Yes, can you book it for 7 people and give me the reference number?
Booked! Reference number is FQB8ZKSP. You will pay 70.7 GBP at the station.
I am looking for a place to stay in the east.
What price range are you looking for?
It doesn't matter as long as it has free parking. Are there any with 5 stars?
There are several places available, however, I do not know if they have free parking, but they do have parking. Are you looking for a hotel or a guesthouse type place to stay.
It doesn't matter to me whether it's a guesthouse or hotel, but I really want it to have free parking. Can you check on that again, please?
I'm sorry there are no hotels that match that criteria. Would you like to try something with a different number of stars?
Can you try a 4 star hotel instead, please?
There are 5 guesthouse's that meet that criteria. Do you have a preference on the price range?
I don't care about the price range. Can you book it for 4 nights? There will be 7 of us and we will be arriving on Friday.
I was able to book a room at Carolina bed and breakfast, the reference number is 168T25C6. Is there anything else you need help with?
Hello, I have been robbed. Can you please help me get in touch with the police?
Parkside Police Station is in Parkside, Cambridge. Their number is 01223358966. Anything else I can do for you?
Can I please have the postcode as well?
The postcode for the Parkside Police Station is CB11JG. Can I help you with anything else?
Was Parkside the address of the police station? If not, can I have the address please?

Do you have one in the south that includes free parking?
I'm sorry, no, none in the south.

i don't have any hotels in the south part of town.

I need to go to bringham new street by 17:30

How about the acorn guest house? It has free internet and parking, four stars and is in the moderate price range? Shall I book that for you?

I'd like to arrive by 15:45.

I'll be heading to huntingdon marriott hotel.

The contact number is 07062991767. Do you have any other questions?

find me a tea house

its called city stop restaurant, serves european food and address is Cambridge City Football Club Milton Road Chesterton

No, it is expensive.

Royal spice is cheap and looks great.

No, there are none fitting that description, sir. Sorry about that.

where can i find tea around me

Monday will be windy, with a low of 60F and high of 70F, somewhat warm.

i hope its in the centre

advice me please of a better duration
five nights starting monday would do better

Sorry, it was not successful. Can I check another hotel or shorten the stay?
Then I can I get one on Saturday for 5 nights?
I was able to book that for you, your reference number is DFHZ0ZL8.

Could you give me the address, phone number, and postcode?

The closest chinese restaurant is PF Changs, located 5 miles away.
OK, please give me an address and directions via a route that avoids all heavy traffic.
P.F. Changs route set to 669 El Camino Real with only moderate traffic noted.
I need to book a tax departing from gandhi.
What is your destination and when would you like to depart?
I'm going to broxbourne train station and i need to arrive by 02:00
I have you in a Red Lexus, 07595414661 is the number to call if you need to speak to them.
Wonderful, thanks for your help.
My pleasure. Do you need any other assistance while in town?
Hello, I'm looking for a train from Cambridge to Norwich.
Certainly, there are many trains going that route. Can you specify which day you'd like to travel?
Sorry. I want to leave on Saturday after 20:30.
There is a train Saturday at 20:36. Does that work for you?
Yes that works great can I book that for 5 people please?
I have confirmed booking for 5 tickets, your reference number is CID6UHHF. The total fee is 70.4 GBP payable at the station. Can I help with anything else?
Hi! Can you give me some information on the Golden Curry restaurant?
The golden curry is an expensive indian restaurant located in the centre of town. Is there anything else you would like to know?
That sounds great. I would like a table for 5 people at 19:00 on tuesday.
Unfortunately, that day/time are unavailable. Would you like me to try a different time or day?
Okay try 18:00 instead.
That time is available, so I've made your reservation. The reference number is OSHZUPSD. What else can I do for you?
That's all that I needed today, thanks!
Great. Glad I could help. Enjoy your meal.
Could you help me find a moderately priced 4 star hotel?
Unfortunately, I don't have any hotels meeting those requirements, but I do have several guesthouses that do. Would you be interested in one of those?
Yes, I think that would be fine. Something in the north, please.
I have 7 guesthouses in the north that are moderately priced and 4 stars, are you looking for internet or parking?
Not really. As long as it's in the north it's good.
When and how long are you wanting to stay? I can see what is available.
I need it for 4 nights starting on wednesday.
One more question. How many people are in your party?
Please make the reservation for 2 people.
There are 7 guesthouses that fit your needs. May I recommend Arbury Lodge Guesthouse?
Sure, that sounds fine. Can you book that for me?
There is no availability at Arbury on Wednesday, unfortunately. Would you like to try a different hotel?
Sure, choose one for me.
Unfortunately, there is no availability at any of the 7 guesthouses for your needs. Do you want to book for another day or for a shorter stay?
How about for 3 nights?
That did the trick. I was able to book for 2 people for 3 nights starting Wednesday at the Acorn Guest House. Reference number is G591ZUVT.

I have 318 trains running on Wednesday, to help narrow it down where will you be departing/arriving?

Yes. Thank you very much.

Can you find me a taxi from backstreet bistro? I can't leave until after 14:15.
Ok, what is your destination?
I want to be taken to cineworld cinema
When do you need to arrive?
By 15 00 and I need car type and contact number
Booking completed! Booked car type : black skoda Contact number : 07336608269

I will be departing from Ely and traveling to Cambridge.
Okay, and what time do you want to leave after or arrive by?
I need to arrive by 11:45.
There are 3 trains here. Do you want me to book any tickets?
Yes please. I need it to be booked for 8 people.

I would recommend you try Grafton Hotel Restaurant. As requested it is in the east and serves British food.

please try booking at 1200hrs and get me the reference number

utterances_en: I'm looking for a train from norwich to cambridge.
What day would you like to leave and is there a particular time you would like to arrive by?
I would like to leave on Tuesday and arrive by 13:30.
I am sorry there are not trains to arrive at 13.31. The first train leaves at 5:16 and arrives at 6:35. The trains depart every hour.
Ill just take earliest train then please.
How many tickets would you like?
I don't need you to reserve it but I do need the train info and the travel time.
The train id is TR0839 and it leave at 11:16 and arrives by 12:35.
Can you tell me what the total travel time for that is?
The total travel time is 79 minutes.
Can you help me find some cheap Italian food?
I have Ask at 12 Bridge Street City Centre.
Thanks for your help. Can I get their phone number and other info as well?
Sure, their phone number is 01223364917 and their post code is cb21uf.
show me directions to the nearest starbucks
I'm sorry, There aren't any Starbucks nearby
Do you have any coffee shops? The one with the quickest route please.
Coupa is nearby.
I need to leave peterborough and arrive by 20:45. Can you book a train for me?
What time would you like to depart?
I will depart any time so long as the train arrives by 20:45.
OK, and what day do you need to travel?
Oh, I need to leave this Saturday. Just to clarify I want to leave Peterborough going to Cambridge.
TR7143 will arrive in Cambridge Saturday by 20:38, it will depart peterborough at 19:48. Does this suit your needs?
Yes that is perfect. Can you book that and give me a reference number?
Yes I booked it and your reference number is 6793D7ED. Will there be anything else?
I am looking for kirkwood house.
Kirkwood House is a 4-star, moderately priced guesthouse in the north area of town. Do you need more information?
Yes, what is the address, please?
The address for Kirkwood house is 172 Chesterton Road, CB41DA. Can I help you with anything else?

It doesn't matter.

Thank you. What is the postcode?

The address is 196 Mill Road City Centre, postcode cb13nf.

The Bridge Guest House is a 3 star guesthouse. It is in the south area. Would you like to book a room?
Yes, please, for four people.
How many people is the reservation for?
Four. Two nights. Beginning Saturday.
I am afraid that booking is unsuccessful. Would you like a different day or amount of days?
How about 1 night? Would that work?
This booking is successful for 1 night. Your reference number is 85BGKWO4. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

Sure! What is your destination?
I need to go to the Cambridge arts theatre.

I actually need to leave on Saturday.
Let me confirm you are traveling from Cambridge to Stevanage this Saturday. Also, what time do you want to leave or arrive?
I am in Cambridge traveling to Stevanage on Saturday. I want to arrive in stevenage by 12:45.
Train ID TR3259 Price 10.24 pounds Reference number is : 1P6X7B88.
I'll also need the travel time please.
The travel time is 19 minutes.
Ok, great. Thanks!
Thank you for using our services, do you need any further assistance?
I need information on the fitzwilliam museum
Ok, I can help you with that. What kind of information do you need?
Can I get the phone number, address, and area it is located in?
Of course, the Fitzwilliam Museum is located in the centre area of town, at Trumpington street, and can be reached at the phone number: 01223332900. Do you need anything else?
Are there any Australian food places in the south part of town?
I was not able to find any Australian restaurants in the south part of town
Are you sure? I am really looking for an expensive Australian place to dine in the south.
Yes, there are no expensive Australian restaurants in the south part of town. Would you like to look in a different area?
No, lets keep the same area but see if there might be an Indian restaurant instead.
How about Taj Tandoori? It is an expensive Indian restaurant in the south side.
Okay. I want to book a table for 5 people at 16:30 on sunday.
I was not able to book you a table for this time. Would you like to try a different day or time?
Can you see if a table is available at 15:30?
I was able to book a table of 5 for 15:30 at Taj Tandoori on Sunday. Your reference number is HJZCPH80, your table will be reserved for 15 minutes.
Great thank you for your help today.
It was my pleasure. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
Please book me a taxi to arrive by 12:45 to the city stop restaurant.
And where are you departing from please.
I'll be departing from jinling noodle bar

Ok I need to book this taxi and I need the contact number and car type please.
A grey Audi is booked to come pick you up.
contact number please !

Unfortunately, there are no eastern European restuarants in the south part of the city. Is there anything else you want?
I'm looking for an expensive eastern european place in the south.

The trip is 79 minutes.

There are 3 guesthouses and a hotel. Do you have a star rating that you enjoy staying at?
No not in particular.
I have four hotels. Do you know the area you would like to stay?
I'd prefer a guesthouse in the north, please.

Sure! Their phone number is 01223244955 and postcode is cb58rg. Is there anything else I can help with?

I'm headed to churchill college
I have confirmed a booking for a yellow honda.

Ok, there are 2 guesthouses located in the centre of town. They are in the cheap price range. Would you like to book one?
Do they both include free parking?
Yes, they both have free parking.
How about internet? Can I get wifi for free?
Yes, they both have free wifi as well.
Know any good bites around here?
I have a wide range of places I can recommend. First, why don't I ask if there is an area in the city that you prefer to dine in?
I would like to dine in the south, preferably Chinese and expensive.
We have two in that area. There is "peking restaurant" and "the good luck chinese food takeaway". Would you like to book a table at one of these options?
Can I just get the address for the Peking Restaurant?
Absolutely - the Peking Restaurant is located at 10 Homerton Street City Centre, cb28nx. Can I help with anything else today?
I'm looking for a 3 star hotel.
There are 6 hotels listed at 3 star. There are 2 in the north, 1 south, 1 west and 1 centre. Would you like more information?
I don't care where the hotel is located, but I'm looking for something in the moderate price range.
I have 4 options for you. Do you need free wifi and parking? I have 3 that offer these and 1 that does not.
Yes please. Can you recommend me of them?
The hamilton lodge is nice and in the north area. Would you like a booking today?
No, thank you. Can I just get the address, please?
The hamilton lodge is located 156 chesterton road. Would you like me to help you with anything else?
Could you let me know where in town I would find a hospital?
Addenbrookes Hospital is located at Hills Rd, Cambridge. Is there a particular department you're looking for?
I'm looking for the postcode and phone number
The phone number is 01223245151, postcode CB20QQ

I want the route that is the quickest and has the least traffic

Yes, set the navigation to Coupa please.
I sent all the directions on your screen, enjoy your trip!
I'm looking for a train. The train should depart from cambridge and should go to broxbourne
What day are you traveling?
I'm traveling on tuesday and I want to arrive by 16:15
TR6357 leaves at 05:01 and arrives at 06:01. Would you like me to book a ticket for you?
No, but I do need the price.
Alright. The price for TR 6357 is 17.90 pounds. Anything else?
Can you found me a swimming pool in the south part of town?
Unfortunately I was unable to find a pool at the south part of town, however we have some north east and at the centre
What about a type of park?
There are five, including wandlebury country park in the south.
Wandlebury country park is fine. Can I get the entrance fee?
Actually, they have free entrance. They are located at Wandlebury Ring, Gog Magog Hills, Babraham. Their phone number is 01223243830. Their postcode is cb223ae.
Thanks for the info. I will give them a call.
You're welcome. Can I help you find anything else?
I have to get to the gandhi by 09:15. Can you help me?
I would be happy to help with your request, where will you be departing from?
I'm departing from Golden Wok.
I've booked you a blue lexus, the contact number is 07462575401.

utterances_en: I'm looking for a place to stay in the north side.
There are many guesthouses and hotels on the north side. Do you have any preferences?
I would like for the place to be 0 stars but has to include free wifi and free parking.
I found the City Centre North B and B. Would you like me to book you a room?
Yes. I want to book it for 8 people, starting Sunday, for 3 nights.
Okay, your all set. The reference number is 0IS0GU49. Can I do anything else for you?
find me directions to the nearest hotel
The nearest hotel is The Westin.
Give me the address.
The Westin is located at 329 El Camino Real which is 4 miles away with no traffic.
Schedule a football activity with my aunt on the 5th at 4pm.
Ok, football activity at 4pm on the 5th with you aunt has been added to the schedule.
I'm looking for a chinese restaurant in city centre.
How does Charlie Chan's sound?
Is that in the expensive price range?
No, Charlin Chan is a cheap place. The Ugly Duckling is an expensive Chinese restaurant though, is that what you would like?
Could I have their phone number and address?
I'm sorry, the Ugly Duckling does not have any phone number listed but is located at 12 St. Johns Street City Centre.
Do you have any other options for expensive Chinese, and can you make sure that have a number and address listed as well.
Sure, the Tang Chinese is also an expensive Chinese restaurant in the centre of town. Their phone number is 01223357187. Is there anything else that I can help you with?
I'd like their address please.
They are located at Napier Street City Centre
I am looking for a place to stay. The hotel doesn't need to have free parking and should have a star of 4
What area of town would you like?
preferably the north side of town or somewhere near a shopping center
Great, I have found several guesthouses but unfortunately no hotels in the north side that are rated 4 stars. Would you be interested in something like that?
I would prefer a hotel, is there one that has free wifi?
The University arms hotel sounds like something you'd like!
That sounds great. Can you give me their address and postcode?
Sure! The address is regent street and the postcode is cb21ad.

Tôi muốn đến đó trước 12:45.

Willows Market nằm cách đó 5 dặm, tại địa chỉ 409 Bollard St, nhưng có một chướng ngại vật trên đường gần đó.
Có cửa hàng tạp hóa nào khác gần đó trên con đường nhanh không? Nếu không, xin hãy chỉ cho tôi lộ trình đến Willow Market.
Tôi e rằng đó là cửa hàng tạp hóa duy nhất trong khu vực này. Đang thiết lập bản đồ.

There are a few of them. Would you prefer the centre of town or the west area?
How about the center?
There are a few restaurants that will meet your needs. I suggest The Copper Kettle at 4 Kings Parade City Centre.
Please book a table for 3 at 14:15 on Friday at The Copper Kettle.
I was able to book a table for you at 14:15 at the Copper Kettle. Your reference number is 3ED8CQBU. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
i am looking for a train. The train should leave on Monday and should arrive by 12:45.
Where would you like to go?
I would like to depart from Cambridge, and travel to Bishops Stortford.
Is there a time you would like to be picked up by?
I want to get there by 12:45.
The TR7928 goes from cambridge to bishops stortford on monday at 11:29 arriving at 12:07. Shall I book that for you?
I need to book it right now but what is that travel time?
The travel time on TR7928 is 38 minutes. Should I book it for you?
What is the price for that train?
The price is 10.10 pounds per ticket. I can make those reservations for you if you'd like.
I am looking for a restaurant that is moderately priced and served British food.
What part of area would you like to visit?
How about the center? I need a reservation for 8 people at 14:15 on a Friday.
The oak bistro is one of several restaurants that match your description. Would you like me to book a table there for that time?
Yes, that would be fine. Is there a table for 8 available?
I'd be happy to make your reservation. What time and day would you like that for?
Friday at 14:15.
They do not have a table for 8 available at 14:15 Friday. Would you like to try for another day or time slot?
Can you try to book it for 13:15?
That time worked, your reservation was successful and your reference number is X4U272EC. Can I help you with anything else?
give me a quick route to a grocery store
Willows Market is 5 miles away at 409 Bollard St but a road block is nearby.
Is there another grocery store nearby on a quick route? If not please give me directions to Willow Market.
I'm afraid that's the only grocery store in the area. Setting navigation now.

utterances_en: Hello Cambridge Towninfo Center representative. I desire a place to stay that 5 stars, cheap and includes free wifi. Can you help?
I'm sorry but I'm not finding anything that matches your criteria. Can I help with something else?
How about changing that to a 4 star rating?
That we have! Do you have a preference on the area?
No preferences on the area, but I want to book it for 1 person for 5 nights starting from wednesday.
How does the Alexander bed and breakfast in the centre sound?
Sounds great! Could you book it for 1 person for 5 nights starting Wednesday?
Booking was successful. Reference number is : 34P1OHBR. Do you need any other help today?
i want a place for dinner and serves a mexican food,where can i find it?please first pick for me a taxi to that place should be to the north.
Unfortunately, I was unable to find a Mexican restaurant in the north. Is there anything else I can help you with?
How about a chinese restaurant?
The hotpot sounds like a good idea. Need a reservation?
Yes, please. 6 people at 11:30 on sunday.
I'm so sorry, but I wasn't able to make that reservation for you. May I try on another day or at another time?
Yes, let's shoot for the same thing but on Wednesday instead, okay?
I was able to get you that reservation on Wednesday. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes prior to your arrival.
May I have the reference number please?
Absolutely, the reference number is W92C2Z47. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
That was all. Thanks
Did you say you also needed a taxi to the restaurant?
Can you recommend a place to stay that has free WiFi? I need something in the moderate price range.
I have got quite a few that should suit your needs. Is there a preference on what area of town you stay? That might help narrow down the options.
In the centre, please. Also, free parking.
Unfortunately, I am not finding anything that meets all of your requirements. Would you mind if I searched another area of town?
Can you see if there's anything in the east?
The Carolina Bed and Breakfast and the Warkworth House. They both have free wifi and parking and they both fall in the moderate price range. Do either of these sound good?
Great. Can you give me the phone number and address for The Warkworth House? Also, is it a guest room?
yes, it is a guesthouse and their phone number is 122 336 3682.
Can I have the address of the hotel?
The address is warkworth terrace.
Thank you very much!
You're welcome. What else can I do for you?
In the next 48 hours will it rain in alhambra?
Just a little: the weather in Alhambra will be drizzle today and overcast tomorrow
Help, I injured my eye! I am looking for the nearest hospital with the cambridge eye unit.
You can contact them at 01223257168.
What's the address and postcode?
The address is Hills Rd, Cambridge and the postcode is CB20QQ. Do you need help with anything else?
